title: Story premise ENT100: The One-Trip Grocery Pride
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (everyday microdramas). Hook: One trip. Seventeen handles. A questionable victory. Takeaway/theme: A self-imposed rule can be dropped when it makes the task worse.
description: A shopper insists on carrying every empty prop bag in one trip, turning into a wobbling tower of handles. They set everything down, make two easy trips, and discover that the dramatic ONE TRIP badge can be folded into a useful shelf label reading TWO IS FINE.
